name: uwvm-llvm-full-debug
description: Attach VS Code to a host-authorized UWVM LLVM-full debugger broker

capability.description: Windows broker capability. Use a prompted input; never commit it.

moduleId.description: Defined Wasm module for source breakpoints; defaults to 0.

pythonPath.description: Host Python 3 executable for the DAP adapter.

stepLevel.description: Default statement stepping level. Source requires embedded -g DWARF; wasm/native stepIn executes exactly one Wasm/native instruction. Explicit line/instruction requests remain source/native. Native enables bounded current-function disassembly display after a real owned-code query; source/wasm references do not grant native code access.

configurationSnippets.label: UWVM LLVM Full: attach to Unix broker
configurationSnippets.description: Attach after an owner-authorized Linux/macOS broker has launched the VM.

configurationSnippets.label: UWVM LLVM Full: attach to Windows broker
configurationSnippets.description: Attach to an owner-authorized named pipe with a prompted capability.
